import re
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("empty duration")
    # plain integer seconds
    if text.isdigit():
        return int(text)
    # find components
    pattern = re.compile(r"(\d+)([dhms])", re.IGNORECASE)
    pos = 0
    total = 0
    seen = set()
    last_index = -1
    for m in pattern.finditer(text):
        if m.start() != pos:
            # there is unmatched text
            raise ValueError(f"invalid format at position {pos}")
        num = int(m.group(1))
        unit = m.group(2).lower()
        if unit in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate unit")
        # enforce decreasing order
        unit_order = {u: i for i, (u, _) in enumerate(_UNITS)}
        cur_index = unit_order[unit]
        if cur_index <= last_index:
            raise ValueError("units not in decreasing order")
        seen.add(unit)
        last_index = cur_index
        # add seconds
        size = dict(_UNITS)[unit]
        total += num * size
        pos = m.end()
    if pos != len(text):
        raise ValueError("trailing characters")
    return total
